newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Absa mulls tapping international markets.
newsitem.headline: Absa mulls tapping international markets.

text.p: Amalgamated Banks of South Ltd said on Wednesday that it was still mulling the possibility of raising cash overseas.
Last year the group postponed plans to issue new ordinary shares, fully or partly represented by global depositary receipts, to international investors due to tough market conditions.
But the firm said the plan, which would have raised cash to finance existing and new international operations, was still on the cards.

"The possibility of raising permanent capital abroad will continue to be explored in market circumstancees which will provide Absa with the opportunity to raise such capital in the most flexible, advantageous and cost-effective manner," the firm said in a statement with its annual report.
